variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID used by the sources that keep their catalog view in WH_CATALOG_COMMON to read and update WH_CATALOG_COMMON (catalog Lookup and watermark Script).

variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_NAME
variables.note: Common warehouse holding the catalog views of the sources that keep their catalog view in WH_CATALOG_COMMON.

variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_SQL_ENDPOINT
variables.note: SQL endpoint of WH_CATALOG_COMMON (needed by the catalog Lookup connection).

variables.name: EPTW_CATALOG_VIEW_NAME
variables.note: Catalog view of EPTW: tables to ingest, load mode, active flag, watermark.

variables.name: EPTW_CATALOG_WATERMARK_TABLE_NAME
variables.note: Watermark table of EPTW in WH_CATALOG_COMMON, updated after each successful run.

variables.name: EPTW_KEYVAULT_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID (Web v2 to the Key Vault) used to read the API key header of LS_CORE_REST_EPTW.

variables.name: EPTW_LH_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID used by the EPTW pipelines to read and write Lakehouse files (Copy activities).

variables.name: EPTW_LH_NAME
variables.note: Name of LH_SDS_EPTW: the notebooks look the lakehouse up by this name in the workspace they run in (no attached lakehouse needed).

variables.name: EPTW_REST_SERVICE_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID replacing linked service LS_CORE_REST_EPTW.

variables.name: EPTW_REST_SERVICE_CONN_NAME
variables.note: Fabric connection name replacing linked service LS_CORE_REST_EPTW.
